title: Agent Middleware
summary: This module provides a collection of middleware components designed to enhance and modify the behavior of agents, offering functionalities like tool call limits, PII detection, summarization, and tool emulation.

nodes.label: Create Agent
nodes.title: Agent Creation
nodes.description: Initializes and configures an agent graph, integrating various middleware components and tools.

nodes.label: Subagent Transformer
nodes.title: Subagent Promotion
nodes.description: Promotes nested named agents into typed handles for independent consumption and monitoring.

nodes.label: Model Node (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Model Execution
nodes.description: Handles synchronous model requests, applying middleware processing before and after model invocation.

nodes.label: Model Node (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Model Execution
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous model requests, applying middleware processing before and after model invocation.

nodes.label: Tool Node
nodes.title: Tool Execution
nodes.description: Executes tools and adds their responses to the messages list, potentially wrapped by middleware.

nodes.label: Model Call Limit Middleware
nodes.title: Model Call Limiter
nodes.description: Tracks and enforces limits on the number of model calls, with configurable exit behaviors.

nodes.label: Model Fallback Middleware
nodes.title: Model Fallback Handler
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed model calls with alternative models in sequence until success.

nodes.label: Model Retry Middleware
nodes.title: Model Retry Mechanism
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed model calls with configurable backoff on specific exceptions.

nodes.label: PII Middleware
nodes.title: PII Detection and Handling
nodes.description: Detects and handles Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in conversations using various strategies like redaction or blocking.

nodes.label: Shell Tool Middleware
nodes.title: Persistent Shell Tool
nodes.description: Registers a persistent shell tool for agents, allowing command execution within a controlled environment.

nodes.label: Summarization Middleware
nodes.title: Conversation Summarizer
nodes.description: Summarizes conversation history when token limits are approached, preserving context continuity.

nodes.label: Todo List Middleware
nodes.title: Todo List Management
nodes.description: Provides agents with a 'write_todos' tool to create and manage structured task lists for complex operations.

nodes.label: Tool Call Limit Middleware
nodes.title: Tool Call Limiter
nodes.description: Tracks and enforces limits on the number of tool calls, with configurable exit behaviors.

nodes.label: LLM Tool Emulator
nodes.title: Tool Emulation
nodes.description: Emulates specified tools using an LLM instead of executing them, useful for testing.

nodes.label: Tool Retry Middleware
nodes.title: Tool Retry Mechanism
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed tool calls with configurable backoff on specific exceptions.

nodes.label: LLM Tool Selector Middleware
nodes.title: LLM Tool Selector
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to select relevant tools before calling the main model, reducing token usage and improving focus.

nodes.label: Context Editing Middleware
nodes.title: Context Editor
nodes.description: Automatically prunes tool results to manage context size, applying edits when token counts exceed thresholds.

nodes.label: Filesystem File Search Middleware
nodes.title: Filesystem Search
nodes.description: Provides Glob and Grep search tools over local filesystem files for agents.

nodes.label: Human-in-the-Loop Middleware
nodes.title: Human Intervention
nodes.description: Enables human intervention in agent execution, allowing for approval, editing, or rejection of tool calls.

nodes.label: Provider Tool Search Middleware
nodes.title: Provider Tool Search
nodes.description: Defers selected tools behind provider-native tool search, reducing request payload size.

nodes.label: Codex Sandbox Execution Policy
nodes.title: Codex Sandbox
nodes.description: Launches the shell through the Codex CLI sandbox for enhanced security and syscall restrictions.

nodes.label: Docker Execution Policy
nodes.title: Docker Sandbox
nodes.description: Runs the shell inside a dedicated Docker container for strong isolation between sessions.

nodes.label: Detect Credit Card
nodes.title: Credit Card Detection
nodes.description: Detects credit card numbers in content using Luhn validation.

nodes.label: Output Tool Binding
nodes.title: Structured Output Tool Binding
nodes.description: Manages metadata for structured responses generated via tool calls, including schema and tool implementation.

nodes.label: Provider Strategy Binding
nodes.title: Provider Strategy Binding
nodes.description: Manages metadata for native structured output, including schema and parsing logic for provider-enforced JSON.

nodes.label: Write Todos (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Todo Writing
nodes.description: Synchronously creates and manages a structured task list for the current work session.

nodes.label: Write Todos (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Todo Writing
nodes.description: Asynchronously creates and manages a structured task list for the current work session.

nodes.label: PII Stream Transformer
nodes.title: PII Stream Redaction
nodes.description: Mutates streamed content-block-delta text to redact PII in flight, ensuring scrubbed text for consumers.

groups.label: Agent Orchestration
groups.title: Agent Orchestration
groups.description: Components responsible for creating and managing the overall agent workflow and graph execution.

groups.label: Model Interaction
groups.title: Model Interaction
groups.description: Components handling direct communication with language models, including synchronous and asynchronous calls.

groups.label: Tool Management
groups.title: Tool Management
groups.description: Components related to the execution, selection, and emulation of tools within the agent's workflow.

groups.label: Middleware Functions
groups.title: Middleware Functions
groups.description: Various middleware components that intercept and modify agent behavior, such as limiting calls, retrying, and handling PII.

groups.label: Security and Execution Policies
groups.title: Security and Execution Policies
groups.description: Components defining and enforcing security policies for tool execution, such as sandboxing and PII detection.

groups.label: Todo Actions
groups.title: Todo Actions
groups.description: Specific actions for managing todo lists within the agent's capabilities.
